Its original technology detected malicious content online for social platforms' trust and safety teams, and that work continues alongside a newer line securing generative AI. The WonderSuite platform covers the AI lifecycle: WonderBuild stress-tests models and agents before launch, WonderFence applies runtime guardrails in production, and WonderCheck red-teams deployed systems continuously. Alice Labs runs its frontier research on model evaluation. The company says it protects more than 3 billion users across over 120 languages, and is co-headquartered in New York and Tel Aviv.
